description: This Java class 'LoanJournalEntryCreatedBusinessEvent' defines a specific type of business event related to journal entries, particularly indicating when a loan journal entry has been created. It extends 'JournalEntryBusinessEvent' and implements 'NoExternalEvent', suggesting it is an internal event within the system.

classes.name: LoanJournalEntryCreatedBusinessEvent
classes.description: Represents a business event indicating that a loan journal entry has been created. It encapsulates the journal entry object and provides event-specific information such as type and aggregate root ID.

methods.name: LoanJournalEntryCreatedBusinessEvent
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the event with a specific JournalEntry object.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the event as a string.

methods.name: getAggregateRootId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the aggregate root associated with this event, specifically the loan transaction ID.
